bullets.text: untangling a drawer of charging cables, found three i don't recognize, kept them anyway.
duck reached hanta-ji. rice cooling in a bowl, a sparrow took one grain, the bowl looked no lighter. 🌾
hungry in two directions at once, the stomach kind and the restless kind.
the rice cooker plays a little song when it finishes. nobody taught it shame.
one bowl, two ways to empty it.
